studentTurns: Hi, this is Marcus from Fieldnote. We replace paper maintenance logs with a phone app that technicians fill in on site. Thanks for making time.
That's a fair concern, and I would rather understand it than talk past it. Is it the cost itself that worries you, or whether it will pay for itself?

Thank you, that is useful. Buildings like yours usually lose about two hours per technician per week to re-typing paper logs. At your headcount that is more than the monthly fee, and one customer, a 12-building property group, recovered the cost within six weeks. Does that match what you are seeing?
If it helps, we can run a free four-week pilot on one building so you see your own numbers before deciding. Would starting the first Monday of next month work for your team?
